text:
Eliot Park: hey team — Eliot here (started today, infra eng). Quick setup snag: my Mac MDM enrollment is stuck on 'Applying' for >30m. Tried rebooting. Any quick troubleshooting steps? Also hi! Fun facts: used to be a pastry chef, so I will bring croissants one week :croissant:

Rachel Ng: welcome @Eliot Park!! 🎉 pinging @IT Support Bot. First things to try: 1) System Settings → Profiles → remove any half-applied profile 2) Re-run the EMM enrollment link from the invite email 3) If still hanging, capture /var/log/install.log and serial number and we'll open a ticket. If you want a faster dev setup, we can give you a cloud dev box this afternoon.

IT Support Bot: Thanks Rachel — ticket created: TCK-4729. Assigned to @Matt O'Connor. Please reply with serial number and a screenshot if possible.

Samira Khan: hey @Eliot Park — welcome!! For onboarding slack channels: #eng-runtime, #devex, and #lunch-plans are good to join. Also our onboarding checklist is pinned in #new-hires.

Matt O'Connor: @Eliot Park if you can paste the serial and the short tail of the install log that'd help. Temp workaround if you need to code now: use the ephemeral cloud devbox — ssh info below.

```
ssh eliot@devbox-42.redwood.ai
# creds in 1Password entry "devbox/eliot"
```

Oliver Chen: welcome! Also — cookie bake-off idea approved if you actually bake >:D. I bring surprisingly aggressive chocolate chip cookies. :cookie:

Eliot Park: thanks for the fast replies. serial: C02XK1M8LVCF. here's the last lines from /var/log/install.log — it looks like the MDM payload download timed out:

```
2025-11-07 09:12:03 install: starting MDM enrollment
2025-11-07 09:12:15 mdmclient: downloading payload from https://mdm.redwood.ai/push/abcd1234
2025-11-07 09:14:43 mdmclient: download timed out after 120s, retrying (1)
2025-11-07 09:17:43 mdmclient: download timed out after 120s, status=408
2025-11-07 09:18:01 install: enrollment stuck in Applying
```

Matt O'Connor: perfect, thanks. I'll try to repro with that payload id and escalate network side. Meanwhile you should be able to use the cloud devbox. If you prefer we can ship a temporary laptop image or give a USB recovery image to IT.

Rachel Ng: also, FYI Eliot — your onboarding buddy is Samira, she'll schedule a quick 30m sync later today to go over infra repo layout. Welcome again!

Eliot Park: appreciate it all — I'm in #eng-runtime and #devex now. Looking forward to the croissant and meeting everyone in person. :party_popper:
